name: simple-blog-system
description: MERN blog with JWT auth, OAuth, RBAC, admin panel and real-time notifications

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -n db,api,web -c green,blue,magenta "npm run db" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
